title: Email reminder
languageNote: Choose your reminder language and select Save preference. You can change it here at any time. Changing the website language does not change this preference.
label: Email me one reminder about my favorites
description: Optional. At most one reminder per account, 24 hours after your latest addition or enabling reminders, whichever is later. An empty favorites list cancels the wait. You can turn reminders off at any time.
enabled: Email reminders are enabled for this account.
disabled: Email reminders are off. Your favorites are still saved.
error: Couldn’t confirm your reminder preference. Please try again.
outdated: The reminder information has changed. Reload your preference before choosing again.
